*Saraṇaduka, Maggārammaṇattika* (Patthana 15.85) is a canonical Abhidhamma text located within the Paṭṭhāna division of the Pali Tipiṭaka. As indicated by its title, the text belongs to the combinatorial analysis of conditional relations in the Paṭṭhāna, examining the intersection of the *Saraṇaduka* (the dyad of *saraṇa*) and the *Maggārammaṇattika* (the triad of *maggārammaṇa*).

 These reuses occur with related analytical sections of the Paṭṭhāna, most prominently *Saraṇaduka, Tika* (Patthana 3.14, with segment ranges §1.1–3.1 aligning with §58.1–62.1), *Saraṇaduka, Dassanenapahātabbadukādi* (Patthana 18.29, sharing §1.1–3.1 with §2.1–4.1), *Kusalattika, Tika* (Patthana 5.1), *Sārammaṇaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.38), and the preceding section *Saraṇaduka, Micchattaniyatattika* (Patthana 15.84) [DharmaNexus].
